name: invoiceflow
idea: Free professional invoice generator — create, customize, and download PDF invoices instantly in the browser. No sign-up required.
why_trending: Freelancing and solopreneurship are at an all-time high in 2026. Millions of new freelancers need simple invoicing tools that don't require expensive subscriptions.
why_profitable: Invoice tools monetize well via ads, premium features (custom branding, recurring invoices, payment links), or a one-time Pro upgrade. Similar tools charge $10-$30/month.
why_easy: 100% static HTML/CSS/JS — no backend, no database, no auth. Works on GitHub Pages instantly. Print-to-PDF built into every browser.
